snippet.title: Remnants Of R'lyeh | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Halloween 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
Remnants of R’lyeh is a Lovecraftian first-person survival horror set deep beneath the waves. Explore a decaying underwater city, uncover its dark secrets, fight grotesque creatures, and struggle to survive as reality and madness begin to blur. Wishlist the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1794000/Remnants_of_Rlyeh/
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.

Website: https://thehorrorgameawards.com/
Merch: https://store.thehorrorgameawards.com/
